scope: Shared operations queue authority and cross-team work visibility

sources.meaning: Latest Vercel queue-update commit for V-001.
Recent Cloudflare queue-update commit names C-001.
Recent Frontier queue-update commit names R-027.

claims.claim: CURRENT_STATE names V-001 as the active delivery item and ACTIVE_QUEUE contains only V-001.
Recent repository history contains committed team outputs for C-001 and R-027 after the canonical queue timestamps.
ACTIVE_QUEUE is presently a partial delivery view, not a complete cross-team work ledger.
Cross-team reconciliation should be additive: ingest dedicated queue-update artifacts into a derived queue index, then promote to canonical state only through an explicit authority rule.
The repository does not currently identify which team or process has authority to merge additive queue updates into ACTIVE_QUEUE.
Absence from ACTIVE_QUEUE can be treated as evidence that no other team item exists.

contradictions_resolved.contradiction: Canonical queue shows one item while repository history shows multiple team item identifiers.
contradictions_resolved.resolution: Treat canonical queue as authoritative for delivery gating but incomplete for cross-team continuity; treat committed team queue updates as observed work evidence without silently promoting them.

privacy_boundary.included: Repository operational metadata, public commit identifiers, queue semantics, and governance inferences.
privacy_boundary.excluded: Private chat text, personal health, relationship, financial, symbolic, or identity material.

next_action: Build a deterministic derived queue-index generator that reads additive queue-update artifacts, preserves source commit and status, and reports conflicts without changing ACTIVE_QUEUE.
